description: This file contains CRUD operations for managing users, onboarding profiles, portfolios, holdings, suggestions, subscriptions, and integrations in a financial investment application using SQLAlchemy.

methods.name: Optional[models.User] get_user_by_email(db: Session, email: str)
methods.description: Fetches a user from the database by email.

methods.name: models.User create_user(db: Session, email: str, password: str, full_name: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Creates a new user with a hashed password.

methods.name: Optional[models.User] authenticate_user(db: Session, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Authenticates a user by verifying email and password.

methods.name: models.Onboarding upsert_onboarding( db: Session, user_id: int, experience_level: Optional[str], risk_tolerance: Optional[str], goals: Optional[str], markets: Optional[str] )
methods.description: Creates or updates the onboarding profile for a user.

methods.name: models.Portfolio get_or_create_default_portfolio(db: Session, user_id: int, currency: str = "USD")
methods.description: Fetches or creates a default portfolio for a user.

methods.name: List[models.Holding] list_holdings(db: Session, portfolio_id: int)
methods.description: Lists all holdings within a specified portfolio.

methods.name: models.Holding upsert_holding( db: Session, portfolio_id: int, symbol: str, quantity: float, average_price: float, market: str )
methods.description: Creates or updates a holding position for a specific symbol within a portfolio.

methods.name: models.Suggestion create_suggestion( db: Session, user_id: int, symbol: str, action: str, rationale: str, target_price: Optional[float], market: str )
methods.description: Creates an investment suggestion for a user.

methods.name: List[models.Suggestion] list_suggestions(db: Session, user_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches all suggestions for a specific user.

methods.name: models.Subscription set_subscription(db: Session, user_id: int, is_active: bool, plan: str)
methods.description: Creates or updates a user's subscription details.

methods.name: models.Integration upsert_integration(db: Session, user_id: int, provider: str, access_key: Optional[str])
methods.description: Creates or updates an integration setup for a user.
